## AWS Cloud Club 2026–27 Kickoff

AWS Cloud Club 2026–27 学年启动会

**时间 / Date & Time：** 2026 年 10 月 29 日，4:00–5:00 PM PT\
**地点 / Location：** Gould Hall 322，UW Seattle\
**官方链接 / Official URL：**\
[https://huskylink.washington.edu/rsvp_boot?id=375323&rel=title](https://huskylink.washington.edu/rsvp_boot?id=375323\&rel=title)

**中文介绍（150–200 字）：**\
这是 UW AWS Cloud Club 的新学年启动活动，主要用于介绍组织团队、未来活动安排和参与方式，并帮助新成员认识对云计算感兴趣的同学。官方说明未列出技术演示、workshop 或具体议程，因此本场的核心价值更偏向发现社群和建立初步联系，而不是立即学习 AWS 服务或云架构。对于希望进入 cloud、DevOps、distributed systems 或 AI infrastructure 方向的学生，它可作为了解后续技术活动、寻找项目伙伴及接触同方向同学的低成本入口。活动仅一小时，适合先参加并评估社群质量。

**English introduction (150–200 words):**\
This kickoff introduces the AWS Cloud Club at the University of Washington, its organizing team, and its plans for the 2026–27 academic year. The event is positioned as a social orientation where students can meet other members, learn what the club does, and hear about upcoming programming. The published description does not promise a technical workshop, cloud demonstration, or detailed presentation, so its immediate educational value is likely modest. Its stronger value is as an efficient entry point into a community centered on cloud computing and related technologies. Students interested in AWS, DevOps, distributed systems, backend infrastructure, cybersecurity, or AI infrastructure may use the hour to identify future technical events, meet possible project collaborators, and learn how actively the organization supports builders. Attendees should arrive with targeted questions about planned workshops, cloud credits, certification preparation, projects, hackathons, and relationships with industry speakers. Because it is short and held on campus, the cost of evaluating the community is low. The long-term value will depend on the depth and consistency of the club’s later programming.

**活动亮点 / Highlights：**\
中文：认识 AWS Cloud Club 团队与成员；了解全年计划；寻找云计算相关项目、学习和合作机会。\
English: Meet the AWS Cloud Club team and members, preview the year’s plans, and discover cloud-related learning or collaboration opportunities.

**适合人群 / Best For：**\
中文：对 AWS、云计算、DevOps、分布式系统、后端工程或 AI infrastructure 感兴趣的 UW 学生。\
English: UW students interested in AWS, cloud computing, DevOps, distributed systems, backend engineering, or AI infrastructure.

**注意事项 / Notes：**\

English: The event is primarily social and introductory, with no technical content announced. HuskyLink may require sign-in to complete registration.
